syllabus.overview: NTA has published the official 17-page JEE (Main) 2027 Syllabus covering Paper 1 (Mathematics, Physics, Chemistry), Paper 2A (Mathematics, Aptitude Test, Drawing Test), and Paper 2B (Mathematics, Aptitude Test, Planning).

primary_pdfs.title: Official Syllabus for JEE (Main) – 2027 (Paper 1, Paper 2A & Paper 2B)

subjects.name: Mathematics (Paper 1, 2A & 2B)
units: Unit 2: Complex Numbers and Quadratic Equations
Unit 5: Binomial Theorem and its Simple Applications

subjects.name: Physics (Paper 1)
units: Unit 7: Properties of Solids and Liquids
Unit 13: Magnetic Effects of Current and Magnetism
Unit 14: Electromagnetic Induction and Alternating Currents
Unit 17: Dual Nature of Matter and Radiation

subjects.name: Chemistry (Paper 1)
units: Physical Chemistry (Units 1–8): Basic Concepts, Atomic Structure, Chemical Bonding, Chemical Thermodynamics, Solutions, Equilibrium, Redox & Electrochemistry, Chemical Kinetics
Inorganic Chemistry (Units 9–12): Classification & Periodicity, p-Block Elements, d- and f-Block Elements, Coordination Compounds
Organic Chemistry (Units 13–20): Purification & Characterisation, Basic Principles, Hydrocarbons, Halogens, Oxygen, Nitrogen, Biomolecules, Practical Chemistry

subjects.name: Aptitude, Drawing & Planning (Paper 2A & 2B)
units: Part-II Aptitude Test (2A & 2B): Awareness of persons, buildings, materials, textures; 3D perception, scale & proportion, mental rotation, transformation of 2D/3D forms
Part-III Drawing Test (Paper 2A — Offline A4 Sheet): Sketching scenes/activities from memory, 2D/3D composition using geometrical shapes, transformation of forms
Part-III Planning (Paper 2B — CBT): General Awareness, Social Sciences (national/urban development, demographics, geography), Thinking Skills (comprehension, maps, analytical reasoning)

exam_pattern.overview: JEE (Main) 2027 is conducted in Computer Based Test (CBT) mode for Paper 1 and Paper 2B, and hybrid mode for Paper 2A (CBT for Mathematics & Aptitude + offline A4 drawing sheet for Drawing Test). All Section B numerical questions are compulsory (no optional questions).

tie_breaking: 4. Less proportion of number of attempted incorrect answers and correct answers in all subjects
5. Less proportion of number of attempted incorrect answers and correct answers in Mathematics
6. Less proportion of number of attempted incorrect answers and correct answers in Physics
7. Less proportion of number of attempted incorrect answers and correct answers in Chemistry
8. If tie still persists, candidates will be assigned the same rank
exam_pattern.normalization: Multi-shift raw scores are normalized into Percentile Scores (up to 7 decimal places) per shift: 100 × (Number of candidates appeared in the shift with raw score ≤ candidate's score) ÷ (Total candidates appeared in that shift). Best of the two Total NTA Scores is used for candidates appearing in both sessions.

eligibility.age_limit: No age limit for appearing in JEE (Main) 2027. Candidates who passed Class 12 / equivalent in 2025, 2026, or are appearing in 2027 are eligible irrespective of age (subject to admitting institute age criteria, if any).
eligibility.attempt_limit: A candidate can appear in JEE (Main) in three consecutive years (2025, 2026, and 2027 for candidates who passed Class 12 in 2025), with up to two sessions per year.
eligibility.qualifying_exam: Passed Class 12 / equivalent examination in 2025 or 2026, or appearing in 2027 (10+2 system of Central/State Board, Intermediate/Pre-University, 3-year AICTE/State Diploma, Senior Secondary NIOS with at least 5 subjects, or AIU-recognized foreign board).
subject_requirements: Paper 1 (B.E./B.Tech.): Passed qualifying exam with Physics and Mathematics as compulsory subjects along with one of Chemistry / Biotechnology / Biology / Technical Vocational subject.
Paper 2A (B.Arch.): Passed qualifying exam with Mathematics, Physics, and Chemistry.
Paper 2B (B.Planning): Passed qualifying exam with Mathematics.
eligibility.state_of_eligibility: Determined by the State/UT from which the candidate passed (or is appearing in) the Class 12 qualifying examination — NOT by native place or residence. For NIOS candidates, the State of Eligibility is determined by the State in which the Study Centre is located.

steps: Visit the official JEE (Main) portal at https://jeemain.nta.nic.in/ once the Advance City Intimation Slip (30 Dec 2026) or e-Admit Card (13 Jan 2027) link is activated.
Log in using your JEE (Main) 2027 Application Number, Password / Date of Birth, and Security Pin.
Verify candidate photograph, signature, barcode, exam date, shift timing, reporting time, and test centre address.
Carry printed e-Admit Card along with valid original Government Photo ID and self-declaration / PwD scribe certificate (if applicable).
